required_patches.description: Pass the resolved lld path as argv[0] instead of the literal "ld.lld", so MLIR's ROCDL target finds the linker when it is not on PATH under that name.
Support waves_per_eu min,max range attribute for full VGPR utilization.
Allow overriding xnack=any codegen to xnack- or xnack+ on gfx1250 via LLVM_GFX1250_ANY_XNACK_CODEGEN env var.
Use another sequence for initial unclaused vmem on AMDGPU.
Improve the sequence for initial unclaused VMEM on AMDGPU.
Avoid register pressure limit underflow when the reserved-register weight meets or exceeds the target-provided limit.

Define gfx1250-strict on this pin and hand-port the functional follow-ups: clause scope breaks, cluster-load M0=0, 64 LDS banks, unscaled f8f6f4 WMMA promotion, WMMA latencies, drop gfx1200 SWMMAC, and disable f4 WMMA, block16 cvt-scale, e5m3, and 16x16x128 FP8 WMMA on strict. Also model the VOPD3 FP64 OPY hazard and reserve ENABLE_WAVEFRONT_SIZE32 on wave32-only targets. Adapted because those commits do not apply directly.

Add sched.bank / sched.vgpr / sched.sgpr / sched.agpr hints on pin 941a04e. Retargeted from the patch written against 1df311a6: keep the functional changes and drop the clang-format-only churn that does not apply here.
required_patches.upstream_status: not yet submitted; adapted from jli/schedule-bank-gpr-llvm-head (LLVM 1df311a6)
